policy: Every current product line has one row. Time-of-day quota or price rules live only in data/calendar-rule-registry.json; a row names the rules and the monitored sources that state them. Statuses: modelled, none-found, unverified, ended. Rows are re-checked whenever their sources are reviewed, and a row not re-checked within 30 days becomes a review item (#295).
